about: A realm forked, on the wire (made.proto, GitHub #13250), taken from what the server answers today: seed the realm, make each call under /api/playtest/realms as its owner or a stranger (a key no player has), and the server answers with this status and body. "message" names the body: MadeReply (made.proto: SQL's object and the page realms.c adds), MadeLines (the ?as=lines text), ForkInfo (a fork pane's lines), ForkPublishReply, RouteError (record.proto), ErrorReply (the API's own refusal) and ErrorWords (a refusal's words alone, for a caller that reads lines). "request" names the request's message. metaverse-engine/editor/made-goldens.coax reads every answer and writes every fork's body through metaverse-engine/editor/made.coax; coax/web/api/tests/realm_record_checks.coax makes the calls.

realm.seed: INSERT INTO verse.players (id, key_sha256, created_ms) VALUES ('p-fork-fixture', encode(sha256(convert_to('fork-fixture-player-key-0001', 'UTF8')), 'hex'), 1); INSERT INTO verse.worlds (id, owner_player, created_ms) VALUES ('made-fork-fixture', 'p-fork-fixture', 1); INSERT INTO verse.made_realms (slug, world, name, style, ground, time, features, tools, made_ms) VALUES ('fork-fixture', 'made-fork-fixture', 'Fork Fixture', 'lowpoly', 'grass', 'day', '[{"feature":"trees","count":4}]', '{"fly":false,"jump":true}', 1);
realm.clean: CREATE TEMP TABLE ff AS SELECT m.slug FROM verse.made_realms m JOIN verse.worlds w ON w.id = m.world WHERE w.owner_player = 'p-fork-fixture'; DELETE FROM verse.realm_publications WHERE slug IN (SELECT slug FROM ff); DELETE FROM verse.realm_revisions WHERE slug IN (SELECT slug FROM ff); DELETE FROM verse.made_realms WHERE slug IN (SELECT slug FROM ff); DELETE FROM verse.worlds WHERE owner_player = 'p-fork-fixture'; DELETE FROM verse.players WHERE id = 'p-fork-fixture';
